test_title: PYST 144: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Friend : Foe :: Die : ?
solution:
**Logic :** Term : Antonym

So,

__
 
• Antonym of **friend** is **foe**.

Similarly,

 
• Antonym of **Die** is **live**.

Hence, **"Live"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• End → Antonyms are beginning or start.
 
• Live → Antonyms are die or deceased.
 
• Life → Antonym is death.
 
• Cry → Antonyms are laugh or smile.
